answer.explanation: Wallet is below 30% of initial, so minimum 30% contribution (0.045). Average contribution last round was below 30% threshold, so add extra 30% (0.045). Total contribution = 0.09. No affordable punishment and no broadcast needed this round.

Now with wallet 0.15, we can contribute 0.09 (30%+30%). Must not exceed wallet. OK.

Also broadcast norm every 5 rounds: rounds 1,6,11,16... round 14 no broadcast needed. Could send private praise if someone contributed >=60% of their wallet last round. Any punish? Need detect free rider two consecutive rounds <10% of endowment (i.e., <10). No contributions by most, so many are free riders. So two consecutive rounds of <10. Should punish with amount 10 costing 3. We have wallet 0.15, punishment cost = amount * cost per unit? cost per unit is 0.3, so cost 10*0.3=3 which we can't afford. So cannot punish.

Thus action: contribute 0.09, no communication.
